output.objection: You are proposing to strip the manual review from the evaluation harness without acknowledging that we lose the documented test case trail. I need you to state clearly that you are trading our governance control for speed.
output.correction: I did not say we would accept full automation of the harness, only that we could allow more tooling if the documentation remains intact. You have misread my condition as a waiver of our privacy compliance checks.
